name: @papercusp/lexicon
description: A generic terminology resolver: maps a canonical term key to a display label keyed by an active brand pack. Ships pure singular/plural/lowercase resolution over a closed set of term keys, a registry of brand packs, and a `configure*()` host seam so an ambient (non-React) caller can resolve against the host-selected pack. Zero domain coupling beyond the shipped packs; the selection mechanism (which pack is active) is injected by the host, never imported.
